items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mary Lou, Klook, Errol Garner, Boo. [INTERVIEWEE] Billy Eckstine, yeah they all came -- you know, good players.

ctx.x: and on the weekend’s man, they partied, especially on the hill there, the Crawford’s Grill. They partied. They would party. The bar was like almost a block long, a long bar. And the bandstand was up on a riser, just above the bar at the end of the bar where there was a little seating area for tables, you know. And people would come in there man, this is the truth man, they’d say run them and the bar would be like this, two and three deep and man they’d pour, buy everybody a drink. I mean, you know, sportsmen.…
Mary Lou, Klook, Errol Garner, Boo.
Billy Eckstine, yeah they all came -- you know, good players. What was the trumpet players, the brothers, and tenor player, trumpet player.
